biography.value:
Nythravel, the Upward Shadow

Species: Shadowsky Spirewyrm
Abyssal Origin: Layer 46 of Azzagrat — Shadowsky
Palanthas Anchor: the Tower of High Sorcery, Shoikan Grove, and the city's magical geometry.

Shadowsky is illuminated from below and throws darkness upward into the heavens. Nythravel embodies that inversion. Its own shadow rises independently of its flesh, and in its wake doors, towers, and roads cease to agree on direction.
biography.public: A colossal Abyssal dragon surrounded by upward-falling shadows and impossible light.

source.license: Private campaign material. Not for distribution.

description.value: The wyrm makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks. It can replace one attack with [[/item Shadow Pin]].
[[/attack extended]]. Hit: [[/damage 3d10 + @abilities.str.mod type=slashing average=true]] plus [[/damage 2d10 type=necrotic average=true]] damage.

Dexterity Saving Throw: [[/save dex 25 format=long]], each creature in a 150-foot-long, 15-foot-wide Line. Failure: [[/damage 9d10 type=radiant average=true]] plus [[/damage 9d10 type=necrotic average=true]] damage, and the creature gains the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage and no Restrained condition.

One creature within 120 feet makes a [[/save dex 24 format=long]]. Failure: [[/damage 6d10 type=necrotic average=true]] damage and the creature is Restrained by its own upward-projecting shadow until the beginning of the wyrm's next turn. Success: Half damage only.
The wyrm teleports up to 90 feet to an unoccupied space it can see adjacent to a shadow, magical light source, or illuminated floor.
Trigger: The wyrm takes damage from an attack. The wyrm reduces that damage by [[/damage 4d10 + 8 average=true]], then may teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

The wyrm can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures; those spaces are difficult terrain. The first time on a turn it enters another creature's space, that creature must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take [[/damage 4d10 type=bludgeoning average=true]] damage, be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space, and have the Prone condition. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
The wyrm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

While within Abyssal Palanthas, the wyrm is considered to be inside its lair. Its death permanently damages the planar correspondence between its native layer of Azzagrat and the mortal city of Palanthas. Nythravel anchors Shadowsky to the Tower of High Sorcery and the impossible geometry of Shoikan Grove.

Magical and nonmagical Darkness does not impede the wyrm's vision. It can see Invisible creatures within its Truesight if those creatures cast a shadow. Its own shadow always projects vertically upward regardless of the direction of light.
If the wyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. In its lair it has 5 uses; outside its lair reduce the maximum to 4.

Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the wyrm can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Shadow Rend. The wyrm makes one Rend attack.

Ascend. The wyrm uses Climb the Shadow.

Pillar of Night. A vertical column of opposing radiance and necrotic shadow erupts.
[[/attack extended]]. Hit: [[/damage 3d10 + @abilities.str.mod type=slashing average=true]] plus [[/damage 2d10 type=necrotic average=true]] damage. This Legendary Action costs 1 use.
The wyrm uses [[/item Climb the Shadow]].

Choose a point within 120 feet. A 15-foot-radius, 60-foot-high column erupts. Creatures in it make a [[/save dex 24 format=long]], taking [[/damage 4d10 type=radiant average=true]] plus [[/damage 4d10 type=necrotic average=true]] damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the wyrm can use one lair action; it cannot use the same lair action two rounds in a row unless the GM chooses otherwise for a mythic scene.

Ground-Sun Flare. A 30-foot-radius area explodes with light from beneath. Creatures there make a [[/save con 24 format=long]], taking [[/damage 4d10 type=radiant average=true]] damage and gaining the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn on a failure, or half damage without Blinded on a success.

Ascending Shadows. Choose up to three creatures whose shadows are visible. Each makes a [[/save dex 24 format=long]] or gains the Restrained condition until initiative count 20 of the next round.

Impossible Doorway. Choose two visible creatures within 120 feet. Each unwilling creature may make a [[/save cha 24 format=long]]. If neither unwilling creature succeeds, the two creatures exchange positions.
